trap.label: the + superlativo
trap.wrong: She is more tall of the class.
trap.right: She is the tallest in the class.
trap.why: Em português 'a mais alta da turma' usa de; em inglês superlativo leva the e in. Adjetivos curtos usam -est.

mcq.q: He is ___ student in the class.
She is the best ___ the team.

fix.wrong: She is tallest in the class.
fix.right: She is the tallest in the class.

rewrite.answer: He is the tallest in the class.
It is the best in town.
This is the most expensive in the shop.
